   - Drop each ore instantly via `sdk.sendDropItem` (1 tick), keeping inventory empty, so no full-inventory stalls/depletion pauses
   - Stayed clustered on 3 adjacent iron rocks (3284-3286, 3368-3370) to minimize movement
